Given the observation $Hwax=0$ and the counterfactual intervention $Pexu=1$, the result must be $Rukz=1$. Next time, I will immediately interpret "A or B causes C" as a deterministic logical disjunction in the absence of other modifiers. I will calculate the outcome of the counterfactual ($0 \lor 1 = 1$) and answer "Yes" with a concise explanation explicitly stating that the intervention on Pexu satisfies the condition for Rukz to occur, overriding the absence of Hwax.
